title: Ele não botou fé no KizuBot
concept: One real customer chat walked top to bottom: he 'não botou fé', seven days later 'Bot joga muito kkk', and the best part for him is that it runs virtually and alerts on WhatsApp; each line is zoomed in the print and made loud in a Pop Bold quote block.
